guardian.main.desc: Server auditing and rollback configuration for Guardian.
guardian.main.general.enabled.desc: Starts the Guardian runtime when the server starts. Changing this requires restart.
guardian.main.general.verboseStartup.des: Logs optional integration detection and additional startup diagnostics. Changing this requires restart.
guardian.main.logging.desc: Master controls for the audit pipeline.
guardian.main.logging.enabled.desc: Enables live audit capture while keeping storage available for lookup and rollback. This can be changed at runtime.
guardian.main.storage.desc: Persistent audit database settings. SQLite is the default backend.
guardian.main.storage.backend.desc: SQLite is bundled in standard builds. DuckDB requires a DuckDB-enabled build or a separately supplied driver. Memory is non-persistent. Changing this requires restart.
guardian.main.storage.sqliteFile.desc: SQLite filename inside the server's guardian directory. Paths and directory traversal are not accepted.
guardian.main.storage.duckDbFile.desc: Used only by optional DuckDB support. Existing files are not automatically converted to SQLite.
guardian.main.storage.warnWhenNonPersist: Warn at startup when the non-persistent memory backend is selected.
guardian.main.performance.desc: Bounds for the asynchronous audit writer. These settings require restart.
Maximum number of accepted audit snapshots waiting for the writer. Saturation is reported as backpressure and never silently discarded.
guardian.main.performance.batchSize.desc: Maximum number of audit entries written in a single storage transaction/batch.
guardian.main.performance.flushIntervalM: Maximum idle wait before the writer wakes to process pending work.
guardian.main.integrations.desc: Optional integrations and their safety limits.
guardian.main.integrations.detectWorldEd: Reports WorldEdit/adapter detection in startup diagnostics; the BML core itself remains free of WorldEdit API imports.
guardian.main.integrations.usePermission: Uses Fabric Permissions API when present (including LuckPerms providers) and falls back to vanilla operator levels. Changing this requires restart.
guardian.main.logging.playerBlockChanges: Captures successful player block placements and breaks, including exact block state and block-entity data.
guardian.main.lookup.desc: Limits for block-history queries and inspector results.
guardian.main.lookup.defaultResults.desc: Default number of block-history rows returned by /co lookup when l: is omitted.
guardian.main.lookup.maxResults.desc: Hard cap for interactive /co lookup result counts.
guardian.main.lookup.inspectorResults.de: Number of block-history rows shown when inspecting a block.
guardian.main.lookup.maxRadius.desc: Maximum cuboid radius accepted by interactive block-history lookups.
guardian.main.rollback.desc: Safety and per-tick limits for the first block-only rollback executor.
guardian.main.rollback.defaultRadius.des: Cuboid radius used by /co rollback when r: is omitted.
guardian.main.rollback.maxRadius.desc: Hard cap for block-only rollback radius.
guardian.main.rollback.maxRecords.desc: Maximum selected block-history rows a single rollback may plan.
guardian.main.rollback.blocksPerTick.des: Maximum claimed block rows Guardian evaluates per server tick. Database work remains asynchronous.
guardian.main.integrations.worldEditLogg: Captures successful WorldEdit block changes through the optional Guardian WorldEdit Adapter.
guardian.main.integrations.worldEditSele: Allows lookup and rollback commands to use an exact cuboid WorldEdit selection through r:#worldedit or r:#we.
guardian.main.integrations.worldEditMaxC: Hard per-operation audit ceiling. Guardian rejects the next WorldEdit mutation before it occurs when this many actual changes have been captured. Requires restart.
guardian.main.integrations.worldEditMaxP: Maximum WorldEdit operations that may be active or still draining through the bulk audit lane. Excess operations fail closed before editing. Requires restart.
